flare.description: Fast iteration: quicker and better at finished-looking layout; use it for drafts, variants and anything a user is waiting on.

sunburst.description: Slower but more literal: honors requested element placement, keeps finer detail and drifts less across multi-round edits; use it for final assets and careful edits.

nova.description: SenseNova native image model: 2K/4K output, strong text rendering, optional logo watermark; set watermark=false for clean images.
